Set shared defaults for function arguments

Source: R/sacha-package.R
sacha_arg_configure.Rd

Store argument values that package functions will use when the corresponding argument is omitted. An explicitly supplied value in a function call always takes precedence. Defaults are shared by name across the functions that accept that argument; for example, species, language, and source can be set once for a report workflow. A configured value is validated by the receiving function when it is used. Passing NULL for a configured name removes that override and restores the function's own default.

sacha_arg_configure(...)

Arguments

...

Named argument values to use as shared defaults. Names must correspond to arguments accepted by the package's supported functions.

Value

The active named defaults, visible for a query and invisible after an update.

Details

The function accepts the argument names supported by the package's taxonomic, spatial, iNaturalist, and report accessors. For report functions, defaults for arguments forwarded through ... are also applied unless the report call or its forwarded arguments provide a value explicitly. Repeated names are rejected to avoid ambiguous settings. Wherever functions expose a retrieval source, its accepted values are consistently "web" and "local". The exact behavior depends on the function. ChecklistBank and ColDP accessors remain web-backed and do not yet expose this selector; a future local backend can follow the same choices.

Supported argument names are catalogue_dataset, colour, crop_area, crop_box, dataset, directory, distribution, dpi, export_comp, export_image, fig_height, fig_width, identifier, image_size, include_auxiliary, kml, language, latex_subfigure_width, limit, local_export, mode, ncol, number_observations, observation_id, observer_name, overwrite, place_id, quality_grade, rank, refresh, save_bib, save_images, save_occurrences, source, species, user_id, verify_local, word_subfigure_width, and zoom_static.

Calling with no arguments visibly returns the active overrides. Updating one or more values changes only those entries and returns the complete set invisibly. sacha_clear_cache() removes all overrides.

See also

sacha_configure(), sacha_clear_cache()

Examples

# \donttest{
inat_images(species = "Bidens andicola", source = "local", number_observations = 1)
#> iNaturalist image query failed: No sufficient local images and metadata were found for the requested query.
sacha_arg_configure(
  species = "Bidens andicola", source = "local",
  number_observations = 2, image_size = "medium"
)
inat_images()
#> iNaturalist image query failed: No sufficient local images and metadata were found for the requested query.
sacha_arg_configure(species = "Bidens andicola", rank = "family")
sacha_arg_configure()
#> $rank
#> [1] "family"
#> 
#> $image_size
#> [1] "medium"
#> 
#> $source
#> [1] "local"
#> 
#> $number_observations
#> [1] 2
#> 
#> $species
#> [1] "Bidens andicola"
#> 
sacha_arg_configure(source = NULL)
sacha_clear_cache()
# }
